candidates.description: This vector represents abstract nouns denoting logical processes, components, or issues in technical and computational contexts.
This vector represents common German verbs in their base or conjugated forms.
This vector represents concepts related to artificial intelligence, cognitive science, and machine learning research.
This vector represents computing, digital technology, and information systems.
German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, and volition.
This feature vector represents common German auxiliary, modal, and copula verbs primarily inflected for tense, mood, and person.
This feature activates on common German verb prefixes and root-like morphs starting with 'ge-', 'ver-', or 'zer-'.
This vector activates for prefixes and roots of analytical, mathematical, and observational operations or terms.
This vector activates on German root words and prefixes related to differentiation, distinction, and variety.
This vector activates common German verb inflections, suffixes, and morphological endings.
